description: This file implements a class and functions to remove fall-through cases from switch statements in an abstract syntax tree (AST) for shader code, ensuring each switch case ends with a break to improve performance and correctness.

classes.name: RemoveSwitchFallThroughTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the AST to remove fall-throughs in switch statements by inserting break statements where necessary.

methods.name: removeFallThrough
methods.description: Static method that initiates the removal of fall-throughs in a given statement list.

methods.name: RemoveSwitchFallThroughTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with the statement list and diagnostics.

methods.name: visitConstantUnion
methods.description: Handles constant union nodes; marked as unreachable in this context.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Handles binary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Handles unary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Handles ternary operation nodes during traversal.

methods.name: visitSwitch
methods.description: Handles switch nodes; does not traverse into nested switches.

methods.name: visitCase
methods.description: Handles case nodes, managing fall-through logic.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Handles block nodes, checking if they always break.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Handles branch nodes, marking the last statement as break.

methods.name: outputSequence
methods.description: Outputs a sequence of AST nodes starting from a specific index.

methods.name: handlePreviousCase
methods.description: Processes the previous case, inserting breaks and managing fall-through.
